controls.control: Unique immutable schema IDs and semantic versions; closed objects unless an explicit extension map exists.
Clean generation drift check and cross-language golden fixtures in CI.
Compatibility classification, migration, rollout order, and security review for changes.

resolution.gate: Every contract change records compatibility class, migration, rollout order, and security impact before merge.

controls.control: Schema examples use synthetic data and pass secret/PII scanning.
Inference has no artifact mounts, public port, runtime egress, or raw text logging.

resolution.gate: The inference runtime passes mount, listener, egress-denial, and telemetry-canary inspection before activation.

controls.control: Cross-language provider conformance covers schemas, Unicode offsets, errors, limits, and model provenance.

resolution.gate: A live provider must pass the shared request, response, Unicode, typed-error, resource-limit, and provenance suite.

controls.control: Rules-only mode is explicit and cannot satisfy a policy requiring contextual evidence.
Model/runtime changes pass frozen accuracy and CPU resource gates.

resolution.gate: Every model/runtime digest change is blocked without frozen per-entity accuracy and reference-CPU resource comparisons.

controls.control: Every detection names extraction revision, code-point offsets, source, detector/model version, type, and score.
Resolution is stable independent of detector completion order and retains all supporting/conflicting evidence.
Detector absence is a capability error, not an empty detection set.
Per-entity evaluation and seeded verification measure the combined system.

resolution.gate: The hybrid bundle cannot qualify until frozen per-entity metrics and seeded verification cover the combined providers.

controls.control: Shared offset library and contract fixtures for surrogate pairs, combining marks, normalization, RTL, and zero-width characters.
All spans validate `0 <= start < end <= length` against the referenced extraction digest.
Normalization occurs only with a recorded reversible source map; no silent normalization at provider boundaries.

resolution.gate: Every adapter/provider conformance suite proves no normalization or validates a reversible source map.

controls.control: Adapters fail unmappable actions rather than clamp or approximate.

resolution.gate: Adapter qualification includes an unmappable-action negative case that blocks output.

controls.control: Egress-denied end-to-end tests and private/default loopback bindings.

resolution.gate: The installed local workflow runs with egress denied and every listener is asserted loopback/private before qualification.

controls.control: No third-party browser assets/analytics or automatic crash reporting.

resolution.gate: The production web bundle and runtime receive dependency, network, analytics, and crash-upload inspection.

controls.control: Model manifests, digests, license/provenance, and explicit activation.

resolution.gate: Model acquisition and activation verify every asset digest, license, provenance field, and explicit operator selection.

controls.control: Capability output clearly states engine mode and any disabled required detector.

resolution.gate: Capability and policy-preflight fixtures prove engine mode plus disabled/unavailable required-detector reporting.

controls.control: Canonical path and file identity checks, symlink containment, generated safe names, and atomic no-clobber creation.

resolution.gate: Adversarial path tests cover aliases, hard links, parent symlinks, case folding, file identity, races, and atomic no-clobber output.

controls.control: Input/output/artifact digests bound into extraction, plan, and verification reports.

resolution.gate: Runtime extraction, plan, writer receipt, and verification reports bind the exact input/output digests and validate canonically.

controls.control: Partial writes remain quarantined and inaccessible through normal download routes.

resolution.gate: Store and interface tests prove staged/failed artifacts cannot be returned through a normal output route.

controls.control: Retention and disk-pressure admission prevent unbounded duplicate storage.

resolution.gate: Quota reservation, retention cleanup, deduplication, and disk-pressure admission tests pass.

controls.control: Report binds output/plan/policy/profile/component digests and invalidates on byte change.

resolution.gate: The canonical runtime report binds every behavior digest and a byte-mutation test invalidates it.

controls.control: Writer receipts reconcile expected action IDs/counts.

resolution.gate: Writer conformance emits a receipt and verification blocks every missing, duplicate, or changed action ID/count.

controls.control: Seeded native-region canaries and residual detectors block supported high-risk formats.

resolution.gate: Every qualified format seeds each declared surface and blocks publication when any canary or residual remains.

controls.control: Publication transition is authorized and atomic; verifier cannot publish directly.

resolution.gate: Publication requires an authorized core transition after immutable verification; verifier interfaces expose no publish authority.

controls.control: Compare-and-swap job revisions, stage leases, deterministic idempotency keys, and outbox events.

resolution.gate: Durable-store conformance covers CAS, lease ownership/expiry, idempotency replay, and transactional outbox behavior.

controls.control: Partial artifacts remain quarantined; terminal/publication invariants are database-enforced where possible.

resolution.gate: Persistence constraints and E2E tests prevent partial artifacts from entering a publishable terminal state.

controls.control: Bounded retries by typed error and component; no infinite poison-job loop.

resolution.gate: Retry matrices enforce per-component budgets and terminal handling for nonretryable or exhausted failures.

controls.control: Recovery, cancellation, duplicate event, and crash-at-every-stage tests.

resolution.gate: The durable-job fault suite covers restart, cancellation, duplicate delivery, and crashes at every stage boundary.

controls.control: Reference benchmark manifests record hardware, OS, runtime, threads, chunks, batch, model digest, and accuracy outcome.

resolution.gate: Every published benchmark contains the complete reproducibility manifest and accuracy outcome.

controls.control: Hard memory/concurrency limits and queue admission prevent host thrashing.

resolution.gate: Reference and low-resource load tests prove hard memory, concurrency, and queue admission bounds.

controls.control: Noninferiority gates are per high-risk entity and exact span, not just aggregate F1.

resolution.gate: Model/runtime optimization is blocked on any high-risk exact-span entity regression beyond its approved bound.

controls.control: Capability manifests expose runtime/precision/device so behavior is reproducible.

resolution.gate: The active model capability contract and snapshot expose validated runtime, precision, and device fields.

controls.control: Policy schema/semantic validation, shallow approved inheritance, deterministic digest, and no remote includes/interpolation.

resolution.gate: Policy compiler conformance covers schema/semantic rules, approved inheritance, digest determinism, and prohibited remote/interpolated input.

controls.control: Preflight distinguishes zero findings from unavailable detector and declares unsupported native features.

resolution.gate: Preflight requirements include detector availability and native feature status, with distinct fail-closed tests.

controls.control: Every exception has principal, reason code, scope, expiry, and audit event.

resolution.gate: Either v1 rejects all exceptions or the exception contract and authorization suite proves every required field and audit event.

controls.control: Bundled policies are examples with no regulatory certification claim.

resolution.gate: Release content review confirms example labeling and absence of regulatory certification claims.

controls.control: Central structured logger with allow-listed fields and safe typed error mapping.

resolution.gate: Logger contract tests reject unknown/sensitive fields and map all public failures to canonical safe errors.

controls.control: Synthetic PII/secret canaries scanned across logs, metrics, traces, reports, snapshots, and diagnostic archives.

resolution.gate: Every implemented sink and diagnostic surface is included in the planted-canary release scan.

controls.control: Bounded metric dimensions and protected retention/access for operational metadata.

resolution.gate: Metric schema, cardinality, retention, and access-control review passes before telemetry activation.

controls.control: Keyed purpose-separated digests only where correlation is explicitly needed and approved.

resolution.gate: Any correlation feature requires purpose approval, separated keys, rotation/retention design, and cryptographic tests.

controls.control: Dependency-boundary linting and public `exports` maps prevent cross-package internal imports.

resolution.gate: Boundary lint enforces the complete allowed package-dependency graph as well as public exports and internal-import bans.

controls.control: Interface equivalence end-to-end tests use the same synthetic job through CLI/SDK/API/web where practical.

resolution.gate: Each shipped interface joins the shared synthetic lifecycle equivalence suite.

controls.control: Core ports abstract providers/adapters/stores; applications are the only composition roots.

resolution.gate: Shared use cases move out of CLI composition and architecture tests enforce provider, adapter, and store dependency direction.

controls.control: Exit codes/UI states/HTTP errors map to the same canonical result and error taxonomy.

resolution.gate: CLI, SDK, API, and web mapping fixtures prove one canonical result/error taxonomy.

controls.control: Probe enumerates encryption, active/embedded/skipped features, limits, and assurance before work.

resolution.gate: The adapter probe contract and conformance suite enumerate every feature state, limit, and assurance claim before extraction.

controls.control: Source map/digest binds canonical spans to native locations; unmappable actions block.

resolution.gate: Source-map conformance binds revisions and native locations and includes fail-closed unmappable actions.

controls.control: Seeded canaries cover every declared content/metadata surface and independent reopen verifies output.

resolution.gate: Each format fixture seeds every declared surface and an independent reopen verifier blocks skipped/residual canaries.

controls.control: Adapters run in job-scoped restricted workspaces with resource and path limits.

resolution.gate: Workspace containment, symlink/path escape, byte/time/resource, and cleanup tests pass.

controls.control: Expected job and extraction revision on every decision; stale updates return conflict.

resolution.gate: Review API/store conformance requires expected revisions and returns canonical conflicts for stale decisions.

controls.control: Browser-submitted spans validate against server-side canonical length/source map and do not include trusted values.

resolution.gate: Negative API/browser tests reject invalid revisions/bounds and value-bearing decision payloads.

controls.control: Review set and decision ordering have canonical digests; plan references the exact digest.

resolution.gate: Replay/digest fixtures prove canonical ordering and exact review-set binding in the plan.

controls.control: Reason codes are bounded and free text is restricted/sensitive if enabled.

resolution.gate: Review schemas bound reason enums and lengths; free text is absent or receives explicit sensitive-data controls.

controls.control: Canaries in text, metadata, annotations, forms, attachments, hidden layers, incremental updates, and image/overlay combinations.

resolution.gate: The PDF malicious/leakage corpus seeds every named recoverable surface and bypass combination.

controls.control: Search/copy/multiple extractor/native object/visual checks bound to the exact output digest.

resolution.gate: All independent PDF verification routes bind results to the exact output digest.

controls.control: Capability warnings and high-risk block for unsupported encryption/fonts/layout/features.

resolution.gate: Capability/preflight matrices expose every unsupported feature and block high-risk output.

controls.control: Focused external security/redaction review before GA claim.

resolution.gate: An independent focused PDF redaction review closes critical/high findings before any qualified claim.

controls.control: Immutable manifests/digests and readiness/capability checks for every active reference.

resolution.gate: The pinned job snapshot names every contract, policy, detector, model, resolver, adapter, strategy, and verifier digest with readiness checks.

controls.control: Asset garbage collection considers active/retained jobs and rollback/support windows.

resolution.gate: Asset-GC tests retain every active/retained reference and configured rollback/support window.

controls.control: Migration creates new revisions, invalidates affected downstream stages, and records actor/reason/from/to.

resolution.gate: Migration tests prove revision creation, dependency invalidation, and complete actor/reason/from/to audit fields.

controls.control: Release/incident tooling queries provenance without reading content.

resolution.gate: Provenance-query tests and incident drills succeed with artifact/content access denied.

validationGates.gate: Every affected boundary has canonical contract tests before its capability is advertised.
Every implemented decision has an end-to-end normal path and at least one injected dependency failure.
Security review confirms logs and errors disclose no document content before production qualification.
Reference CPU benchmarks prove each implemented decision remains practical before qualification.
